s local convention is `index=perfmon`, `sourcetype=Perfmon:Process`; required fields are `_time`, `host`, `object`, `counter`, `instance`, `Value`, `source`, and `sourcetype`. `useEnglishOnly=true` makes the documented English object/counter names portable. Microsoft documents classic Process names as nonunique and potentially unstable; Windows 11+ Process V2 includes PID in the instance name and should be evaluated separately. A 60-second interval is required for the three-of-five design; Splunk

s search-time knowledge exposes the case-sensitive fields `Name`, `RXdropped`, and `TXdropped`; Splunk supplies `_time`, `host`, `source`, and `sourcetype`. The input invokes operating-system tools including `ifconfig`, `ip`, and `ethtool` according to platform and add-on implementation. On Linux, corroborating standard interface statistics are available through rtnetlink (`ip -s -s link`), `/proc/net/dev`, and `/sys/class/net/<interface>/statistics/`. `os` and the 60-second target are deployment choices, not vendor-required values.
